vuFileTools - Version History

Newest versions and release dates are listed first

Release Date Version Release Notes
2026-11-18 Version 5.0 Build 212 Adds automatic dimming behind supported MESSAGE, STOP and HALT dialogs (preselected when Window Dimming is enabled) (including CapeSoft MessageBox), three importable black/blue/red Clarion message procedures, the Custom Message Window extension, and hand-coded custom-message registration functions. See Automatic Message Dimming and Custom Colored Message Procedures.
2026-11-16 Version 5.0 Build 211 Adds Window Dimming with seven vuFT functions, opt-in automatic browse dimming, per-window appearance, manual and START code templates, and runtime controls. The feature is also available separately as cdWindowDim. A compatible EXE manifest is required.
2026-10-27 Version 5.0 Build 210 Added vuRenameDirectory to rename directories on the same volume. Improved vuRun to support longer command lines and avoid unwanted console windows during hidden launches. Corrected hidden-window handling in the RunEx functions. Renamed the three Secure Login password functions to vuFTPasswordInit, vuFTPasswordToggle and vuFTPasswordCleanup to avoid naming conflicts with vuMailKit. Existing Secure Login applications should follow the Build 210 migration instructions.
2026-10-16 Version 5.0 Build 209 Added vuReplaceCharsEx with explicit destination-buffer capacity and all-or-nothing replacement. Corrected vuReplaceChars documentation for its in-place result and numeric return; legacy calling convention is unchanged. Clarified CSTRING example sizes versus actual function buffer limits, including vuRun, and added CSTRING Sizes and Buffer Capacity guidance.
2026-09-08 Version 5.0 Build 208 Fixed a long-standing mailslot bug that could cause messages between applications to be missed or processed incorrectly, and improved mailslot reliability and error reporting.
2026-03-20 Version 5.0 Build 207 Added vuRunExWait and vuRunExDelayWait; expanded the run-function documentation with linked comparison tables on the related run, shell, and print pages; and improved the release documentation structure in What's New.
2026-03-19 Version 5.0 Build 206 Originally added the password visibility helper feature under vuPasswordInit and vuPasswordToggle (names retired from vuFileTools in Build 210).
2026-03-11 Version 5.0 Build 205 Improved vuFileDate and vuFileTime handling and fixed reported issues with certain file path and filename scenarios.
2026-01-03 Version 5.0 Added vuCloseApp and vuCloseAppEx for reliable in-app shutdown control (cooperative close, safety-net forced terminate, optional warning countdown).
2025-12-03 Version 5.0 Added vuInternetPresent and vuInternetCanReachUrl for Internet detection and URL reachability checks.
2025-11-12 Version 5.0 Initial vuFileTools Version 5 release.
2021-06-16 Version 4.3 Miscellaneous improvements.
2018-04-10 Version 4.2 Miscellaneous improvements.
2018-04-02 Version 4.1 Miscellaneous improvements.
2018-01-24 Version 4.0 First LANSRAD release.
